table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
		 dbo.saleledger.custrefno, 
		 date =	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
					 	When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
						When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
						When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
			 		End, 
		/* itemname = CASE saledetail.claimable WHEN 'Y' THEN itempacking.name ELSE item.name END,*/
		  itemname = Case When Max(saledetail.saleitemdescription) IS Null OR RTrim(LTrim(Max(saledetail.saleitemdescription))) = '' THEN item.name Else Max(saledetail.saleitemdescription) END,
		 manufacurer = (dbo.manufacturer.name),
		 specialinstructions = dbo.customer.specialinstructions,
		 looseqty = Sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
		 price = Max(dbo.saledetail.saleprice),
		 rowid = max(dbo.saledetail.rowid), 
 		 cumulativesum = round(0.00,2),
 		 cumulativesumfoot = round(0.00,2)
FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saledetail,    
		 dbo.item, 
		 dbo.itempacking,
		 dbo.Customer,
		 dbo.Manufacturer 

WHERE  CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		 	When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
			When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
			When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
  		 End Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:al_custcode) AND
		 dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode AND
		 dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode AND
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
		 dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode

Group by 
		dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
		dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
		CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		 	When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
			When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
			When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
  		End ,
		dbo.customer.specialinstructions,
		dbo.item.name,
		dbo.manufacturer.name,
		dbo.itempacking.name,
		dbo.saledetail.claimable

order by dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode , rowid
